regeneration.countsAsRegeneration: Counted as regeneration 1 of 2 (maintainer instruction). Reading of the contract: section 9 caps 'complete runs' at 2 and section 10 says 'within the regeneration ceilings'; a literal reading would not count an incomplete run, and the contract does not define the case. Counting it is the stricter reading, nothing in the contract forbids it, so the next regeneration is the last one allowed. Its 323 runner-minutes do not carry over: the 1,500-minute ceiling is per regeneration.
regeneration.decision: Maintainer decisions 2026-10-07 after this record: (1) 'Fix all 5, re-freeze, regenerate': fix PRs for the five causes, a second C1 freeze (which also registers the 62 new Verification tests), then a second and last C2 regeneration; (2) 'Store hashes only': the package binaries are not kept in git.

accounting: runnerMinutes: each job's completed_at - started_at rounded up, no OS multiplier (protocol.json budget.accounting), summed over every job GitHub listed, including jobs that never got a runner (GitHub gives them start and end times). runnerMinutesJobsWithARunner counts only jobs with a runner name.
